title: festuca rubra subsp. nemorum
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. nemorum, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing swelling and pain. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra subsp. nemorum are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-tumor activities.
